baseline_status.reason: OmniPHY is proprietary (DeepSig). CNN of comparable parameter count exists as ablation (TinyCNNDenoiser, 62 params). Full DNN receiver (10^5+ params) would exceed budget and is not reproducible.
Out of scope for NB-IoT NPUSCH focus. LR-FHSS is a different physical layer.

grounded: No existing deep-unfolded receiver addresses joint CFO+channel+detection for LEO NTN IoT
Conventional MMSE degrades at LEO IoT SNR regime
On-board compute constraints are #1 gap in ML-for-SIoT (2025 survey)
NB-IoT NPUSCH pilot structure and frame format implemented faithfully
hypothesis: A ≤1,000-parameter unfolded receiver can outperform MMSE by ≥2 dB at low SNR under LEO Doppler
Delay-Doppler domain denoising exploits channel sparsity for LEO NTN
Weight tying provides good regularization at minimal performance cost
Learned noise precision adapts better than true SNR at mismatched conditions
Soft symbol feedback improves channel estimation at low SNR

blocking_gaps.description: Full BLER vs SNR benchmark requires trained model. With random initialization, BLER values are not meaningful and cannot be compared against baselines.
affected_claims: VAMP-JCD outperforms MMSE by ≥2 dB at low SNR

blocking_gaps.description: FPGA resource utilization, power, and latency on Zynq ZU3EG have not been measured. INT8 quantization requires FINN/Vitis AI toolchain.
Held-out elevation angle performance not evaluated. All benchmarks use 45° elevation. Generalization to 15° and 75° is untested.
MAC count exceeds 10,000 budget at default T=5 configuration (estimated ~15k MACs). Requires T=3 for FPGA compliance.
Novelty claim relies on literature review (grounded) but experimental validation (VAMP-JCD vs baselines at low SNR) is not yet possible without trained model.
affected_claims: First deep-unfolded joint CFO+channel+detection for LEO NTN IoT

blocking_gaps.description: Ablation 7 (quantization sensitivity: INT8 vs FP32) cannot be tested without FINN/Vitis AI toolchain for actual quantization.
affected_claims: INT8 quantization causes <0.5 dB BLER degradation

recommended_next_experiments.experiment: Train VAMP-JCD receiver on synthetic LEO NTN data and measure BLER vs SNR curves. Compare against LMMSE, LS, and Genie baselines.
recommended_next_experiments.rationale: Without trained weights, all BLER measurements are from random initialization and not scientifically meaningful. This is the single blocking gap.
recommended_next_experiments.success_criterion: VAMP-JCD achieves ≥2 dB improvement over LMMSE at SNR=-3 dB with 1.2 kHz Doppler

recommended_next_experiments.experiment: Characterize the performance-complexity Pareto frontier for number of unfolded iterations (T=1..10).
recommended_next_experiments.rationale: Determines optimal T for the target FPGA deployment. T=5 may be suboptimal; T=3 may give equivalent performance at 60% MAC budget.
recommended_next_experiments.success_criterion: Identify knee point where marginal BLER improvement per iteration < 0.2 dB

recommended_next_experiments.experiment: Evaluate VAMP-JCD at held-out elevation angles (15°, 75°) after training at 45°.
recommended_next_experiments.rationale: Tests the generalization claim. LEO satellites transition through elevation angles during a pass.
recommended_next_experiments.success_criterion: BLER gap < 3 dB between 45° train and 15°/75° test

recommended_next_experiments.experiment: Run denoiser ablation study comparing delay-Doppler shrinkage vs element shrinkage vs small CNN vs MLP at multiple SNR points.
recommended_next_experiments.rationale: Validates the core assumption that delay-Doppler sparsity is the right inductive bias for LEO NTN channels.
recommended_next_experiments.success_criterion: Delay-Doppler shrinkage outperforms element-wise by ≥1 dB at SNR=-3 dB

recommended_next_experiments.experiment: Measure gradient flow through VAMP state evolution — check if Onsager correction with learnable β improves training stability.
recommended_next_experiments.rationale: Architecture risk: VAMP may diverge for small N=168 system. Measure whether learned β prevents oscillation.
recommended_next_experiments.success_criterion: Channel estimation NMSE decreases monotonically with training

recommended_next_experiments.experiment: Profile INT8 quantization sensitivity using simulated quantization in PyTorch (torch.quantization) before FPGA deployment.
recommended_next_experiments.rationale: Estimates the quantization loss without needing the FINN/Vitis AI toolchain. Validates whether quantization study is worth pursuing.
recommended_next_experiments.success_criterion: Simulated INT8 BLER gap < 1 dB vs FP32 at SNR=-3 dB

recommended_next_experiments.experiment: Conduct a systematic training study: vary training SNR range, batch size, and learning rate. Report learning curves.
recommended_next_experiments.rationale: Training hyperparameters significantly impact performance. Need to characterize sensitivity.
recommended_next_experiments.success_criterion: Identify robust training configuration (stable convergence across SNR range)
